single_chrome_eight_elements.detail: apply_common_frame (shell/common_frame.rs) composes window title bar (shared WINDOW_TITLE const + ASCII '_ [] X'), menu-bar echo (bar-visible POM options joined by ' | '), FULL tab bar (every tab's BuiltinKind::default_title() [XXX] tag + ASCII 'x' close marker, active wrapped '>TAG x<'), status bar text (Last/Prof/Ln,Col/encoding/Lines + per-Kind segment, NO RUNNING), Message_Line (pushed to model.messages, omitted when empty), and the pfshow key bar (footer, only when key_bar_visible and not the menu path). Centered title stays in model.title; Command ===> left as each per-Context builder set it, so the helper never adds a second title or command line. Live-GUI frame composed by render_status_bar + render_message_line with panel order render_key_label_bar -> render_status_bar -> render_message_line in update.rs.

drawn_once_seam.detail: active_screen_capture is now a thin wrapper: active_context_capture() builds the per-Context model, then apply_common_frame is called once on a ScreenCapture::Model only. SNAPSHOT and CAPTURE share this ONE seam. Dialog-overlay captures and OptOut returned UNFRAMED (frontmost transient / not capturable) -- correct.

box_drawing_both_contexts.detail: render/text.rs now renders model.tables as a box-drawing grid (render_table_grid + push_grid_rule[Top/Mid/Bottom] + push_grid_row) with fixed per-column widths that widen on overflow, Unicode box glyphs or +/-/| ASCII fallback, preserving [value v]/[ v]/____ cell conventions. Full-shell tests prove the frame for a TABLE Context (common_frame_snapshot_table_context_alias_with_second_tab: both [ALIASES] and [CONFIG] tags, box cross glyph, seeded SNAPSHOT row, Last/Prof, no RUNNING) and a markdown_sections Context (common_frame_snapshot_markdown_sections_context_config: menu echo, [CONFIG], Command ===>, Last/Prof, no RUNNING -- general, not Alias-specific). Grid tests: box_draw_table_grid_has_ruled_borders_and_cell_separators, box_draw_table_columns_fixed_width_and_widen_on_overflow, box_draw_table_grid_ascii_fallback; html_table_cells_carry_cell_conventions.

non_blocking_observations.label: Dual status-bar composition paths
non_blocking_observations.detail: The live Status_Bar (render_status_bar builds egui labels + separators) and the snapshot helper (common_frame_status_bar_text builds a ' | '-joined string) assemble the common status segments via two independent code paths. They share the value functions (format_last_action, active_profile_label, encoding/line-count) so values cannot drift, but segment ORDER/separators are duplicated and could diverge in a future edit. Not a defect now; a future refactor could extract a single ordered-segment source. No action required for this change.
